Definition: from a compound of the base of G3466 and ὤψ (the face; from G3700); to shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.
BiblicalUsage: Myopazo means to be short-sighted, to shut the eyes — he that lacketh these things is blind, and cannot see afar off, and hath forgotten that he was purged from his old sins.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the short sight is forgetfulness: he cannot see far because he has forgotten what was done for him close at hand.
